app.title: Mariner's Compass Meteorologia
map.label: Wind and wave map
map.recenter: Back to Enseada de São Francisco
resolution.wide: Regional map built from points 2° apart (about 220 km). It does not show the local wind in the cove.
resolution.bay: Map built from points 0.25° apart (about 28 km). It does not show the local wind in the cove: near the hills, the bridge or the bay entrance the wind can be very different.
source.label: Source: Open-Meteo, model {model}, run of {run}
footer.disclaimer: Numerical model data. Not a substitute for the official Brazilian Navy forecast for navigation.
status.stale: Outdated forecast: the latest run is from {run}.
error.dataExpired: No recent forecast available. Try again later.
error.unavailable: Service temporarily unavailable. Try again in a few minutes.
error.network: No connection to the server. Check the internet and try again.
map.tapHint: Tap the map to see the forecast for a point.
resolution.point: Forecast for the coordinate rounded to 0.25° (about 28 km). Values may differ from the map. It is a model forecast, not a measurement at your location.
point.title: Point forecast
point.partial: The source did not return all the data now. Fields without data show as —.
point.stale: The source could not be reached now. Showing the forecast obtained at {time}.
point.rateLimited: Too many new points were requested now. Try again in {wait}. Points already viewed are still available.
point.quota: The daily limit of new points was reached. Try again in {wait}. Points already viewed are still available.
point.outside: This point is outside the app area.
point.noWaves: No wave data at this point.
point.chartLabel: Meteogram. Use the arrow keys to read hour by hour; with Shift, day by day.
